["If players would like to make the Crawl Mode provide a more in-depth", "experience, you can try playing the Epic Crawl Mode. In this mode, players", "will start a Rank 1 Scenario as a novice, and eventually end at the highest", "Rank Scenario you own in your Middara collection.", "To play the Epic Crawl Mode, start a Rank 1 Scenario of your choice. After", "completing it, keep all your Gold, Items, and XP. Then, perform a Buy Round", "where you purchase new items at the next Loot Level (Common for Rank", "2) and spend XP to purchase new Disciplines. After spending XP and Gold,", "choose a Scenario from the next Rank up. Meaning, players may never play a", "Scenario of the same or lower Rank twice.", "Players will never Gain XP or Gold listed in the corresponding Crawl", "Scenarios after the first Rank. If you’d like to pause your Epic Crawl run, you", "can do so between Ranks. Use the normal rules from the Adventure Mode by", "storing your characters, Items, and Disciplines in a Tuck Bag. You can also use", "an Adventure Sheet to keep track of the current party's Gold and XP.", "If players are ever Defeated, they lose the Epic Crawl. If they win a Rank 4", "Scenario (or a Rank 7 if you have expansions) you’ve won this Epic Crawl run!", "9"]

["When an Adventurer or Combatant Gains Damage tokens equal to", "their maximum HP, they are Defeated. When Defeated, go through the", "following steps:"]

["•", "Remove all Effect, Special Effect, and Ability tokens. If the figure is an", "Intelligent Combatant, remove all Damage tokens. All Tracker tokens", "are required to stay unless the rule in question they are tracking is no", "longer required by the players to track.", "•", "Remove their corresponding figure from the board.", "•", "Remove their corresponding Initiative Card from the Initiative Track.", "When this happens, the other Initiative Cards collapse to fill in the", "empty space."]

["•", "Unless specified otherwise, Combatant tokens are intended to stay", "in play after their corresponding Combatant has been Defeated. If a", "Combatant token is on the card of an Adventurer or Combatant when", "they are Defeated, their token is placed on any space occupied by the", "Adventurer who was Defeated. If more than one space is required,", "choose the nearest legal space.", "•", "A figure can never have more Damage tokens than their maximum", "HP.", "•", "If an Ability or Effect would cause an Adventurer to become Defeated,", "immediately remove the figure form the board. Then, add Damage", "tokens to their card equal to their remaining HP. This does not count", "as Damage being dealt and cannot be interacted with in any way.", "•", "Adventurers and allied Combatants do not remove Damage tokens", "when Defeated. Instead, Defeated Adventurers and allied Combatants", "return to play during the Setup of the next Encounter. During the", "Prepare Phase, all Defeated Adventurers or Adventurers with more", "Damage tokens than half of their max HP remove Damage tokens", "until they have Damage tokens equal to half of their max HP. See", "Setting Up Pg. 14.", "•", "If an Encounter’s Rewards instructs players to Restore, all Adventurers", "and allied Combatants remove allDamage tokens.", "•", "If an Adventurer or allied Combatant is ever revived via an Ability, if", "any rules associated with the placement of their figure or Initiative", "Card are in question, treat them as though they were a Combatant", "Spawning."]

["Due to the nature of boardgames, we have designed Middara around the", "practical idea of component limitations. Meaning, you will rarely be", "required to use a component that you ran out of. However, Middara is", "also inspired by TableTop Miniature and Role Playing Games more than", "anything else. Meaning, we purposely don't want to make our game", "arbitrarily limited.", "If you are instructed to Spawn a figure and all copies of that figure are", "already in play (and you do not have a Variation or Alternate version to", "spawn), do not Spawn anything.", "Store Items and Disciplines are not limited by the components included", "in the game box. However, without additional components, or print and", "play options, you will naturally be limited to what's in the box. Unique", "Items and Wandering Items are intended to be limited by the number of", "copies included as they are thematically unique. While Relics do not", "have a component limit, Adventurers may not have more than 1Relic of", "the same name equipped or in their Pack at the same time.", "Terrain and tokens of all types that do not say they are limited are", "assumed to be infinite. We avoid, to the best of our Abilities, situations", "where this limitation will be violated. In the rare case it does, we", "recommend doing what Role Players do, using any small object around", "your home and your imagination."]

Alternatively, if", "you choose not to re-roll the roll or specific die, you may not choose to", "do so after the step of the Action or effect of the roll has been resolved.", "There is no limit to the amount of times a die or roll may be re-rolled."]

remainingLineTexts: ["Combatants that have both the Alternate and Variation Tag are considered", "Variations of Alternate Combatants.
